project.description: The project this object belongs to.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

subjectFilter.description:
Filter used to find {@link MlSubject}s that belong to this segment.

Note that this filter does not take into account the project's {@link MlProject#subjectFilter subjectFilter}.
To retrieve the subjects that are actually in this segment, one should use {@link subjects}.

parent.description:
If applicable, contains link to parent {@link MlSubject.Group}.
Used when {@link MlSubject.Group} was created as sub-segment of segment.

subSegments.description: If applicable, shows subsegments that was split from this {@link MlSubject.Group}.

subjectGroupByField.description:
If applicable, name of field on {@link MlSubject} (exact type is referenced as
{@link MlProject#subjectType subjectType}) that was used for grouping of subjects.

This field set by {@link #groupBy}. Same value is used in {@link #subjectFilter} as
'subjectGroupByField == subjectGroupByValue'.
Value is stored only for user convenience to show which field of {@link MlSubject} was used to construct this
{@link MlSubject.Group} was constructed for.

See {@link #subjectGroupByValue}.

subjectGroupByValue.description:
If applicable, value of field {@link #subjectGroupByField} on {@link MlSubject} (exact type is referenced as
{@link MlProject#subjectType subjectType}) that was used for grouping of subjects.

This field set by {@link #groupBy}. Same value is used in {@link #subjectFilter} as
'subjectGroupByField == subjectGroupByValue'.
Value is stored only for user convenience to show for which value this {@link MlSubject.Group} was
constructed for.

See {@link #subjectGroupByField}.

title:
Type {@link MlSubject.Group} is a way to group {@link MlSubject}s using filters or grouping on
{@link MlProject#subjectType subjectType}.

To retrieve the subjects in the segment, use {@link subjects}.

{@link MlSubject.Group} for population can be constructed using {@link MlProject#population}.
name: MlSubject.Group
